name: Viettel IDC Hoa Lac 1
notes: Viettel inaugurated its flagship Hoa Lac 1 data center at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park in April 2024; about 21,000 sqm floor area, 2,400 racks and ~30 MW power consumption, TIA-942 Rated 3, first in Vietnam to integrate ~30% renewable power for AI/HPC workloads.

name: Viettel IDC Hoa Lac 3
notes: Viettel IDC's sixth data center at Hoa Lac: about 13,000 sqm and 2,500+ racks, the first facility in Vietnam with an ANSI/TIA-942 Rated-4 component; entered operation around March 2026; maintains PUE below 1.5. Capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Viettel IDC Hoang Hoa Tham (Hanoi)
notes: Legacy Viettel IDC facility on Hoang Hoa Tham street, Hanoi, listed among Viettel's Hanoi data centers by a Viettel solution-reseller page; no official capacity disclosed.

name: VNPT IDC Hoa Lac
notes: VNPT inaugurated its Hoa Lac IDC at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park on 25 Oct 2023: up to 23,000 sqm usable floor space and 2,000 racks, billed at the time as Vietnam's largest and most modern data center; Uptime Tier III (TCCF) design.

name: VNPT IDC Cau Giay
notes: VNPT operates a Cau Giay (Hanoi) data center with roughly 5,500 sqm of data center space and about 399 racks per directory listing; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: FPT Fornix HN01
notes: FPT Fornix HN01 in Hanoi is one of FPT's four large-scale Fornix data centers (HN01/HN02 in Hanoi, HCM01/HCM02 in HCMC) totalling more than 17,000 sqm and 7,000 racks; directory page shows an 8-storey FORNIX building in Cau Giay with about 1,250 racks.

name: FPT Fornix HN02
notes: FPT Fornix HN02 at 10 Pham Van Bach, Cau Giay, Hanoi: 8-storey dedicated data center building with about 1,221 sqm per floor and capacity up to about 1,500 standard racks.

name: CMC Telecom Data Center Duy Tan
notes: CMC Telecom's Duy Tan (Cau Giay, Hanoi) data center earned Uptime Institute M&O (Management & Operations) certification, a first for a Vietnamese operator; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: National Data Center (Trung tam Du lieu quoc gia) No.1
notes: National data center programme approved under Government Resolution 175/NQ-CP (30 Oct 2023); the Ministry of Public Security inaugurated National Data Center No.1 at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park, Hanoi on 18 Aug 2025 - a >20 ha campus among the largest in Southeast Asia with the highest security and green-energy standards; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: NTT Hanoi Thang Long Data Center
notes: NTT-operated colocation data center in Hanoi (Van Phuc, Ha Dong) with about 6,000 sqm colocation space and redundant power/cooling/network; directory-level evidence only.

name: Telehouse Hanoi
notes: KDDI Telehouse colocation data center in Hanoi listed in data center directories; part of Telehouse's Vietnam presence; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: VNIX-HN (VNNIC)
notes: VNIX-HN internet exchange and data center facility operated by VNNIC in Hanoi; national internet-exchange infrastructure, no commercial capacity disclosed.

name: VNPT - LG CNS - KIRA hyperscale AI data center
developer: VNPT with LG CNS and Korea Investment Real Asset Management (KIRA)
notes: Cooperation agreement (19 Oct 2025) to jointly develop a hyperscale AI data center meeting international standards; site not disclosed in the announcement, listed under Hanoi as VNPT Group's base; capacity unconfirmed.

name: Evolution Data Centers VN01 Hanoi
notes: Industry research reports Evolution Data Centers' VN01 Hanoi at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park is already operational; the same firm plans VN02 HCMC (52 MW, Saigon Hi-Tech Park, RFS Q4 2027). Weak/aggregate evidence for VN01.

name: MobiFone Hai Phong Data Center
notes: MobiFone Service Company (Region 5) launched Hai Phong's first data center at the MobiFone building, 68 Pham Van Dong, Anh Dung ward, Duong Kinh district (8 above-ground floors + 1 basement); currently about 50 racks per floor, expandable to about 120; MobiFone is building toward a 7-data-center national portfolio by 2025.

name: Viettel Tan Phu Trung (TPTIP) Data Center
notes: Groundbreaking ~24 Apr 2025 at Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi district; Vietnam's first >100 MW hyperscale data center: up to 140 MW, about 10,000 racks, ~40,000 sqm on a 4 ha site, Uptime Tier III, target PUE <1.4; Phase 1 expected operational by Q1 2026, full build-out before 2030.

name: SGI-HCM AI Data Center Campus (KBC + AIC)
developer: Kinh Bac City Development (KBC), Accelerated Infrastructure Capital (AIC), VietinBank
notes: ~USD 2 billion AI data center campus on a 10 ha site in Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, HCMC, designed for up to 200 MW IT load and about 100,000 GPUs; MoU with VietinBank; construction was targeted to begin 30 Apr 2025 and HCMC set up a fast-track task force; first phase planned as an ~50 MW AI factory.

name: CMC Hyperscale Data Center (Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
notes: CMC secured approval for a hyperscale data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park: initial 30 MW scalable to 120 MW IT load, ~USD 250 million investment, construction slated to begin 2026; AI-as-a-service, cloud and big-data focus with an NVIDIA GH200 GPU farm.

name: CMC Data Center Tan Thuan
notes: CMC's flagship colocation data center at Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7, HCMC; designed by B-Barcelona Singapore to PCI DSS, ISO 27001:2013 and ISO 9001:2015 standards; inaugurated in a ceremony attended by the State President.

name: NTT Ho Chi Minh City 1 Data Center (NTT GDC + QD.TEK)
developer: NTT Global Data Centers & Quang Dung Technology (QD.TEK) joint venture
notes: JV 'NTT GDC HCMC1 LLC' building Vietnam's first global carrier-neutral data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park: 5-storey, ~6 MW IT capacity across 3,100 sqm of server rooms (about 1,200 racks) on a 10 ha plot; cornerstone laid 12 Dec 2024; originally targeted a 2024 launch.

name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 1
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres & VNG Corporation (JV)
notes: Formerly the VNG Data Center (7,800 sqm, usable floor ~12,400 sqm) at Tan Thuan EPZ, District 7; Uptime Tier-3 rated, ISO 27001/27017/27018 and PCI-DSS certified, ~9.6 MW IT load; positioned as HCMC's first carrier-neutral connectivity hub.

name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 2
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres & VNG Corporation (JV)
notes: Second STT-VNG facility in the Tan Thuan cluster, designed for up to 60 MW IT load and linked to STT VNG HCMC1 with access to substations and the HCMC Outer Zone Expressway; announced/planning stage.

name: Evolution DC VN HCMC (VN02)
notes: Hyperscale data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park; investment registration certificate granted ~Apr 2026; USD 508.8 million, 52 MW, Uptime Tier III design upgradeable to Tier IV; ready-for-service targeted Q4 2027; serves cloud, AI and big-data workloads.

name: StarMason Hyperscale Data Center (Sembcorp + BB Holdings)
notes: AI-ready hyperscale data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park; registered capital USD 480.26 million, about 60 MW, Uptime Tier III upgradeable to Tier IV; investment registration certificate granted ~Apr 2026; Sembcorp Development joint venture with StarMason/BB Holdings.

name: FPT Fornix HCM01
notes: FPT Fornix HCM01 in Ho Chi Minh City, one of FPT's four large-scale Fornix data centers (combined >17,000 sqm and >7,000 racks); operational colocation/cloud facility.

name: FPT Fornix HCM02
notes: FPT Fornix HCM02 inaugurated in late 2023 in District 9 (Thu Duc City), adjacent to Saigon Hi-Tech Park: 8-storey facility of ~10,000 sqm with capacity for about 3,600 racks; among the largest data centers in Vietnam at launch.

name: VNPT IDC Tan Thuan
notes: VNPT IDC Tan Thuan (Lot VA, 02C-03A Street 24, Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7) operational since end-2015; about 10,000 sqm and roughly 750 racks; Tier 3 certified; a 2026 Alibaba Cloud operations job posting places its staff at this facility.

name: Viettel IDC Ho Chi Minh City (existing facilities)
notes: Before the Tan Phu Trung campus, Viettel IDC operated five data centers across Hanoi (x2), Da Nang (x1) and Ho Chi Minh City (x2) totalling about 25,000 sqm; the two HCMC facilities are operational colocation/cloud sites.

name: True IDC Tan Thuan
notes: Directory listing of True IDC's Tan Thuan data center in HCMC: about 10,000 sqm of data center space with capacity of about 1,200 racks; aggregate/directory evidence only.

name: QTSC Data Center (Quang Trung Software City)
notes: Data center located within Quang Trung Software Park, District 12, HCMC, per directory listing; small-to-medium colocation facility, capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: MobiFone Data Center Ho Chi Minh City
notes: MobiFone reports equipping/operating data centers in Hai Phong, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City and Dong Nai as part of a build-out toward a seven-data-center national portfolio by 2025; HCMC facility details and capacity not separately disclosed.
